item.title: Contratto di ricerca: NATPRED: Naturalistic Predictions: How our brain anticipates the future in a dynamic world (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

We recently developed a new approach in the lab that combines MEG recordings of participants observing naturalistic dynamic input (e.g., movies), with dynamic representational similarity analysis (dRSA) to quantify both the strength and the millisecond-precision latency of neural representations of naturalistic dynamic input, across hierarchical levels of stimulus complexity (from perceptual-to-conceptual). See [4,5] for relevant previous research from the lab. This fully-funded postdoc position is part of a larger 5-year project funded by the Italian government (FIS starting grant) on which several PhD/postdocs will work.
